
[yellow bold]-- CONCURRENCY -- adv_iot.volt:0[/yellow bold]

Variable `motor_isr_count` is shared between critical task (motor_control) and task (stats). The compiler will mark it `volatile` in generated C.


[cyan]Hint: For multi-word values, consider using atomic operations.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- adv_iot.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- adv_iot.volt:4[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 2 must be LOW during boot for flash programming.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 2
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^[/yellow]
